	potential = {
		antq_law_profile_transoceanic_trigger = yes
	}
	antq_s2_transoceanic_dependent_labor_central = {
		country_modifier = {
			peasants_estate_max_tax = 0.03
			pop_join_rebel_threshold = 0.01
			global_clergy_estate_power = 0.03
			global_clergy_estate_power = 0.02
		}
		years = 2
		estate_preferences = {
			crown_estate
			nobles_estate
			clergy_estate
		}
	}
	antq_s2_transoceanic_dependent_labor_mediated = {
		country_modifier = {
			global_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.02
			nobles_estate_max_tax = -0.02
			global_tribes_estate_power = 0.03
			global_tribes_estate_power = 0.02
		}
		years = 2
		estate_preferences = {
			peasants_estate
			burghers_estate
			tribes_estate
		}
	}
	antq_s2_transoceanic_dependent_labor_local = {
		country_modifier = {
			global_pop_food_consumption = -0.01
			peasants_estate_max_tax = 0.02
			global_peasants_estate_power = 0.03
			global_peasants_estate_power = 0.02
		}
		years = 2
		estate_preferences = {
			nobles_estate
			tribes_estate
			peasants_estate
		}
	}
}
